importantNote: Enforced min-height pre-population for Latest Albums shelf on mobile & constrained playlist track text width to guarantee 100% visible 3-dots option buttons.

items: Enforced 220px min-height & instant album card pre-population so Latest Albums shelf is never collapsed or covered on mobile screens.
Constrained playlist track text width to max-width: calc(100% - 90px) to prevent long song titles/artists from overflowing.
Created a glowing circular 3-dots options button (#38BDF8) locked on the right edge of every playlist track row for instant touch access.
